askFirstHint: Ask first: who will react how, where the risk in this step is…
ideaIf: If I go with “{move}”, who reacts first, and how?
ideaWho: What does {name} care about most right now? What would change their mind?
ideaRisk: Where is the biggest risk in this step? What is the worst that could happen?
ideaUnknown: What don't I know yet that I should find out first?
askNote: Asking doesn't move time · the advisor knows only what you know
redirected: What you wrote as a move was a question, so it is answered here; time has not moved
askIntro: Before you decide, ask anything you want to find out first: who will react how, where the risks are, what you still don't know.
advisorBusy: The advisor is looking into it…
nothingToNote: Nothing to note in this step.
clarifyWhy: The judge could not carry out what you wrote: this part can be read more than one way. Make it specific and leave the rest as it is.
yourMoveLit: Your move as written · the lit parts need saying more plainly
clarifyAfter: Once it is fixed, this is what is done, and only then does time move on
matchedNote: Once two timelines under the same conditions reach the same day, the review sets the outcomes of both choices side by side.
chooseAgain: Choose again from an earlier decision
noDecisions: No decisions yet. Once you have made one, you can go back to it and try another way.
freeText: Starts from the same position; what happens outside is played out afresh.
matched: Choose again under the same conditions
matchedNarrated: What happened outside your control on the original timeline happens the same way on the new one.
matchedText: Keeps the original timeline's public outside events up to {date} and plays out the consequences of your moves again.
matchedLater: Once the original timeline has moved on one more step, this one can be compared.
matchedMissing: This step lacks a full record of outside events.
forkMatched: Choose again from step {step} under the same conditions →
noGoal: This play has no goal set
askedInChat: What you asked for in the chat box
noPolicyChat: None yet. When you ask in the chat box to change the world, the goal or a policy, your own words are kept here.
noPolicy: None yet. Write a lasting intention into a move and it is kept here; you will not be asked again.
withFog: Include what is in the fog
hiddenHappened: {date}: something happened that you do not know about yet
knownBy: Who knows: {names}. A move in the play may bring it to light; otherwise the report reveals it.
noOneSpoke: No one spoke of it openly at the time. A move in the play may bring it to light; otherwise the report reveals it.
noSingleSource: Compiled in research, no single source
endHere: End here and see the review?
endBodyForecast: The review sets out what you learned, the traps you fell into, which steps were luck and which decisions changed the course, and how it all compares with the forecast at the time of research. Once it ends this timeline goes no further, but you can take another way from any step.
endBodyHistory: The review sets out what you learned, the traps you fell into, which steps were luck and which decisions changed the course, and how it all compares with what really happened. Once it ends this timeline goes no further, but you can take another way from any step.
reviewTakes: Writing the review takes about a minute
yourChoices: Your choices along the way · pick one to go back and choose again
standsAndIntends: {name} · where they stand and what they intend
stepUnfinished: This step did not finish: the model service is not responding for now.
notCounted: This step was not counted: the world is still at {date}, and you can submit your decision again.
